info.name: Vibe Coding Fundamentals Assessment
info.main: Test your knowledge of the core concepts, principles, and practices of Vibe Coding with AI, including its manifesto and the roles of Vibe Coders and AI-First Engineers.
info.results: Congratulations! You have demonstrated a solid understanding of Vibe Coding fundamentals and its application in modern software development.

questions.q: According to the 'Introduction to Vibe Coding', what is the primary focus of a vibe coder?

a.option: Writing every line of code meticulously.
The 'what'—the purpose, vision, and potential of the project.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a core value in the Vibe Coding Manifesto?
What does 'Rerolling over debugging' imply in the Vibe Coding Manifesto?

a.option: Ignoring all bugs in the code.
Spending extensive time on manual debugging.
If fixing a bug takes too long, it's often better to regenerate the code with AI.
Debugging should always be done by the AI.

questions.q: What is a key characteristic of a 'Vibe Coder' as described in 'Vibe Coding vs Software Developers'?

a.option: Primary goal is to quickly create engaging user experiences and prototypes.
Emphasis on writing all code manually for quality control.

questions.q: What is the main goal of an 'AI-First Software Engineer'?

a.option: To build strong, scalable, and efficient software by integrating AI throughout the development process.
To primarily focus on the visual 'vibe' of a product.
To avoid using AI tools to maintain code quality.

questions.q: According to 'Welcome to the AI-Driven Vibe Coding', what percentage of code does the author (Alejandro Sanchez) now generate using AI?
What is one of the 'Vibe Coder Superpowers' listed in 'Vibe Coding vs Software Developers'?
Which principle of Vibe Coding states: 'If it doesn't work, reroll. Don't get attached.'?

a.option: Focus on the problem, not the code.

questions.q: What is a key difference in how Vibe Coders and AI-First Software Engineers deal with complexity?

a.option: Vibe Coders avoid complexity, AI-First Engineers embrace it manually.
Vibe Coders use AI to cut through or hide complexity for user experience; AI-First Engineers use AI to manage and optimize complex systems.
Both roles aim to eliminate complexity entirely.
Only AI-First Engineers deal with complex systems.

questions.q: The 'Introduction to Vibe Coding' mentions that vibe coding involves 'seeing stuff, saying stuff, running stuff, and copy-pasting stuff', relying on AI to resolve errors. This process is described as particularly motivating for whom?
One of the principles of Vibe Coding is 'Augmentation over automation'. What does this primarily mean?

a.option: AI should completely automate all development tasks.
AI is a collaborator that enhances human capabilities, not a full replacement for human developers.
Automation is not valuable in software development.

questions.q: According to the Vibe Coding Manifesto, what is valued more: 'Product thinking' or 'Code crafting'?
What is a key benefit of 'Iterating Publicly with AI' as mentioned in the course outline within 'Introduction to Vibe Coding'?

a.option: Keeping your project secret until perfection.
Building confidence and visibility as you progress.
Reducing the need for user feedback.

questions.q: Which statement best reflects the Vibe Coding Manifesto's view on 'perfection'?

a.option: Perfection is the ultimate goal before any release.
Perfection is obsolete if you can always reroll and iterate.
AI tools guarantee perfection in the first attempt.
Striving for perfection in code syntax is paramount.
